title: How Did God Love Us?
question: What does God's love look like in action, and what does He give to those who believe?
blurb: One verse holds the heart of the gospel - trace how God's love gives, saves, and lasts forever.

nodes.content: What does God's love look like in action, and what does He give to those who believe?

nodes.verseText: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.

nodes.content: The verse pairs a gift ('He gave His one and only Son') with an invitation ('everyone who believes'). The love is God's; the response is ours.
Two destinies sit side by side: 'shall not perish' versus 'have eternal life.' Belief in the Son is what moves a person from one to the other.
